_help: Room 1 of Mamie's treasure hunt: the kitchen, and the tutorial. Hand-made so every basic action appears once: read a note, work out a code, pick up, combine, use a tool, use a key. The guide texts are in data/tutorial.json.

clues.text:
Ma chérie Juliette,
Welcome home. Yes, home: the house is yours now.
You know I can't give anything without a riddle, so I made you one last treasure hunt, through the house and back through my life.
The first one is easy. My Saturday market list, the same every week: 3 lemons, 1 little cheese for Chloé, 7 peaches. The kitchen drawers open with my list, in that order.
Take your time. The sun isn't up yet.
Mamie

decoys.text:
Juliette, one more thing, the most important one. Chloé will be hiding somewhere in the house. She does that when she misses someone. She's shy the first time, but she can never resist Gaston, her squeaky seagull.
Please look after her for me. Breakfast at 8, and she likes to sleep where the sun falls on the floor.
Mamie
